name: feishu-next
description: Codex marketplace for Feishu Next workflow orchestration and optional local authorization tooling. Official capability discovery and list compression stay with lark-suite and lark-cli.

plugins.name: feishu-next
plugins.description: Feishu Next connects a user's Feishu operations into complete workflows with step dependencies, explicit identity, evidence and validation. Its bundled workflow router explains official capabilities and selects basic usage, a reusable Next playbook or composition through official lark-suite without copying official skills. Eleven flat public skills preserve direct invocation and non-recursive context handoffs.

plugins.name: feishu-traework-local-auth
plugins.description: Optional plugin to reuse this machine's user-owned TraeWork Feishu authorization with official lark-cli environment credentials. Not the default Feishu Next auth path.
